rule_definition: Every mandatory NSD field mapped to notice output; no required field omitted unless NSD explicitly marks it optional.
Vietnamese static notice lines in generated output must exactly match approved NSD source strings.
Tokens like {{member_name}} or <DATE> must be replaced with runtime values or intentionally blanked per NSD.
Vietnamese punctuation, spacing, and sentence separators must match NSD-approved format.
expected_result: No punctuation variance beyond approved style

rule_definition: Section headers, bullet structure, and ordered blocks follow NSD layout expectations.
Name, dates, IDs, and conditional values match source member profile for each test case.
All Vietnamese diacritics render correctly with no mojibake or replacement characters.
Long Vietnamese strings remain intact without clipping or character loss in generated output.
Grammar, terminology, and legal/benefit intent in Vietnamese remain clear and equivalent to NSD intent.
